label: Reads URL parts in the wrong order
description: The learner treats the query string as part of the path or swaps host and path.

remediation.explanation: A URL reads scheme://host/path?query. Everything before the first / is the host; after ? come parameters.

label: Treats POST as safe to repeat
description: The learner retries a POST on a timeout and creates duplicate orders or charges.

remediation.explanation: GET, PUT, and DELETE are idempotent: repeating them lands in the same place. POST is not; each call can create something new.

label: Swaps PUT and PATCH
description: The learner sends PATCH when they mean a full replacement, or PUT with a partial body.

remediation.explanation: PUT replaces the whole representation. PATCH changes only the fields sent.

label: Treats 3xx as a failure
description: The learner reports a 301 or 302 as an error and does not follow the Location header.

remediation.explanation: 3xx means look elsewhere. The response carries a Location header pointing at the next address.

label: Mixes up 401 and 403
description: The learner cannot tell unauthenticated (401) from unauthorised (403).

remediation.explanation: 401 says who are you; send credentials. 403 says I know who you are and the answer is no.

label: Believes base64 hides secrets
description: The learner base64-encodes an API key and considers it protected.

remediation.explanation: Base64 is encoding, not encryption. It decodes with no key. Secrets live in env vars or a keychain, never in code.

label: Puts secrets in query strings
description: The learner appends the API key to the URL, where it lands in logs and browser history.

remediation.explanation: Send credentials in a header, not in the URL. URLs get logged everywhere.

label: Confuses JSON with JavaScript
description: The learner writes JSON with trailing commas, single quotes, or comments.

remediation.explanation: JSON is stricter than JavaScript: double quotes only, no trailing commas, no comments.

label: Trusts 200 without reading the body
description: The learner treats every 200 as success even when the body carries an error object.

remediation.explanation: The status code and the body are separate signals. Some APIs return 200 with an error envelope; read both.

label: Retries immediately and in a loop
description: The learner hammers a rate-limited API with instant retries, making the 429 worse.

remediation.explanation: On 429 or 5xx, wait before retrying, and grow the wait each time. Honour the Retry-After header when present.

label: Reads a timeout as a server crash
description: The learner assumes a timeout means the server died, rather than the response arriving too slowly.

remediation.explanation: A timeout is your client giving up while waiting. The server may still be processing, which is why blind retries are dangerous.

label: Sends Content-Type on a bodyless GET
description: The learner sets Content-Type on requests that carry no body, and forgets Accept.

remediation.explanation: Content-Type describes the body you are sending. Accept describes the body you want back.
